messages:
Sandeep Rao: Quick sync — we need to lock a retest cadence for the upcoming pen test. Main blockers: (1) ephemeral RBAC roles + TTL, (2) KMS proxy access for readroom artifacts, (3) audit-log retention window for evidence exports. Any objections to a 48h retest window with multiple 4h assessment slots?
Olivia Chen: +1 on 48h. I can own the RBAC part. Proposal: ephemeral roles created via our SSO short-lived sessions, TTL = 4h, max 2 renewals.
Matt Hargreaves: Sounds good. Need to confirm CloudTrail -> S3 export retention is set to 90 days for pen tests (we usually keep 30). Will check and bump if needed.
Lara Kim: For KMS, I want to use our proxy that mints read-only wrapping keys scoped to the readroom job. That avoids sharing raw unwrapped keys. Will need devops to open a temporary port-forward *only* during readroom windows.
Sandeep Rao: @Lara Kim that works. Can you share the KMS proxy command we expect run by ops? Also add checklist for key rotation post-window.
Lara Kim: Sure — snippet below (ops-run):
```bash
# run KMS proxy for readroom (runs in staging k8s namespace)
kubectl -n security port-forward svc/kms-proxy 8443:443 &
export READROOM_TOKEN=$(vault token-create -policy=readroom -ttl=4h)
./kms-proxy --listen 0.0.0.0:8443 --auth-token $READROOM_TOKEN --scopes=wrap,unwrap
```
Sandeep Rao: Nice. @Matt Hargreaves can you confirm port-forward governance and that we can create a pre-signed evidence S3 bucket for the assessor to upload artifacts?
Matt Hargreaves: I can. Ops will run the port-forward from a bastion with session logging. Pre-signed S3 bucket: yes, we create timeboxed presigned URLs (valid 6h) and a separate manifest file. Will also enable object lock for chain-of-custody.
Olivia Chen: For RBAC, plan is to: (a) create iam:AssumeRole with condition aws:MultiFactorAuthPresent; (b) attach least-privilege policy scoped to readroom tags; (c) log session tags to CloudTrail. Example policy snippet I will drop in the ticket.
sec-bot: Reminder: pen-test policy requires retest scheduling published 72h before starting. Missing: assessor contact email in intake form.
Sandeep Rao: Good catch @sec-bot — I have assessor contact now, will update intake.
oncall-sre: Quick oncall note — ensure the fallback runbook is reachable by the assessor if CI fails to export logs. We had one flaky export last time. Ops: add a healthcheck that validates CloudTrail->S3 artifact checksum before readroom opens.
Lara Kim: Added healthcheck to runbook. Also adding automated alert to #eng-oncall if export fails.
Olivia Chen: Action items: 1) I’ll create ephemeral role PR + test (owner: Olivia) 2) Matt to provision presigned bucket + object lock (owner: Matt) 3) Lara to publish KMS proxy runbook + rotate keys (owner: Lara) 4) Sandeep to update intake with assessor contact and publish retest slots (owner: Sandeep).
Sandeep Rao: Timeline: PRs and runbooks done by EOD tomorrow, retest slots published by EOD Friday. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly. :thumbsup:
Matt Hargreaves: Will verify CloudTrail retention and object lock today.
sec-bot: Adding ticket checklist: [ephemeral-roles, kms-proxy, presigned-bucket, healthcheck, auditor-contact].
Lara Kim: One more note — for evidence packaging, assessors want SHA256 manifest. Ops can compute and attach to the presigned upload response.
oncall-sre: Acknowledged. I’ll wire checksum step in the upload lambda.
Sandeep Rao: Thanks all — leaving this thread open for status updates. If PRs are green, we can sign off on the retest plan.
